chapters.title: The Compressed Past
chapters.blurb: A real six-number linear state-space model runs over a forty-eight step signal, and its fading memory is measured by genuine least-squares reconstruction.

chapters.title: Selectivity
chapters.blurb: The copy task run for real: fixed gates blend the flagged token into noise, while Mamba-style input-dependent gates keep it perfectly.

chapters.title: The Convolution Duality
chapters.blurb: One model computed two ways — a step-by-step recurrence and a single convolution — with outputs identical to machine precision.

chapters.title: The Long-Context Trade
chapters.blurb: Honest memory arithmetic: half a megabyte of KV cache per token versus a flat sixty-four megabyte state, a thousand times smaller at long context.

chapters.title: Where This Sits
chapters.blurb: Attention, gated states, and the delta rule face the same rewrite test — three ways to forget, and the bridge to the next book.
